notes: «قال أخبرني أخي» is a relation link: the brother has no name.
Route two is a second isnad for the same saying («سمعت الزهري» makes Sufyan's link to al-Zuhri, rule 5).
«قلت لسفيان أتته ليلا» is a remark by the transmitter about the wording, not a link; «ابن شهاب» and «الزهري» are written as two surfaces and are not merged.
«صفية» is the woman who tells the story, the last link.
